ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly high-intensity white inner surface (~85%) with low-intensity black/grey peripheral boundaries (~15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white central zone. Low-intensity black mapping along the entire trailing edge and lateral margins. Discrete low-intensity pixel clusters (mottling) localized in the proximal central region and scattered across the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along both lobes. Left lobe exhibits low-amplitude variation. Right lobe features a prominent, high-amplitude V-shaped excision interrupting the trailing edge contour.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature of the trailing edges originating from the distal tips toward the medial notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast, beige-toned pixel groupings localized on the distal-most tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, dark, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions visible on the high-intensity surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, V-shaped excision/trauma on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense three-dimensional calcified clusters at the distal extremities of the fluke structure.
